snippet.title: PAC-MAN Museum Trailer
snippet.description:
Revisit your favorite Pac-Man games with Pac-Man Museum!

Available on the PlayStation Network February 25, 2014 and Xbox Live Arcade and Steam (PC) on February 26, 2014.

Download Pac-Man Museum on any platform and get Ms. Pac-Man for free for a limited time!

Follow us on Twitter and join the conversation on Facebook!
https://twitter.com/namcogames/
https://www.facebook.com/NamcoBandai
